name: Ego_Paradox
source:
A young man distances himself from everyone in his life as well as the world itself, declaring it all meaningless. His only desire is to spend the rest of his days in the closest approximation of 'nothing' a living person can achieve. His plans, however, are ruined when his eccentric upstairs (or was it downstairs?) neighbor invites herself into his apartment.

[From [url=https://dreamfishing.itch.io/ego-paradox]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名青年疏远了生命中的所有人，乃至疏远了这个世界本身，断言世间万物皆毫无意义。他唯一的愿望，便是以活人所能企及的最接近“虚无”的状态度过余生。然而，当住在楼上（还是楼下？）的古怪女邻居不请自来地闯进他的公寓时，他的如意算盘彻底落了空。

[摘自[url=https://dreamfishing.itch.io/ego-paradox]itch.io[/url]]
